# Daily Report — 2026-09-28

## Task Completed
Added `list_user_skills` and `get_user_skill` tools targeting the `sys_user_has_skill` table.

- `list_user_skills` — lists user skill assignment records with filters for `user_id` (sys_id or user_name, auto-resolved via sys_user), `skill_id` (sys_id or exact skill name, auto-resolved via sys_skill), and `level` (proficiency level). Returns paginated results with `has_more`/`next_offset`.
- `get_user_skill` — retrieves a single `sys_user_has_skill` record by sys_id with 404 and empty-result guards.
- Both tools normalise `user` and `skill` reference fields to display values.
- Registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
